scripts.text:
[Senior Tracker]
This is our advance base
to stop Morocc.
I'm a tracker
charged with leading my army
to Morocc's lair.
scripts.translation:
[資深追蹤者]
這裡是阻止夢羅克的前進基地。
我是追蹤者，負責引導軍隊前往他的巢穴。

scripts.text:
Your backpack is too full
I can't talk to you!
scripts.translation: 你的背包太滿了，沒法繼續交談！

scripts.text:
You need to reach level 160 first
to enter the Red Flower!
scripts.translation: 進入紅色花朵需要先達到160級！

scripts.text:
[Senior Tracker]
We're nowhere near close
to stopping Morocc's resurrection.
I can't sleep at night,
knowing Morocc is doing everything he can
to recover his strength.
Could you come back tomorrow?
scripts.translation:
[資深追蹤者]
距離阻止夢羅克復活，我們還差得遠。
一想到他正竭盡全力恢復力量，我就夜不能寐。
明天能再來嗎？

scripts.text:
[Senior Tracker]
I knew you'd return.
You look well-rested.
scripts.translation:
[資深追蹤者]
我就知道你會回來的。
你看起來休息得很好。

scripts.text:
[Senior Tracker]
According to my intel,
Morocc is hiding out in this place,
recovering his strength.
scripts.translation:
[資深追蹤者]
據情報，夢羅克就藏在這裡，正在恢復力量。

scripts.text:
[Senior Tracker]
Fighting Morocc
takes more than a few warriors, no matter how strong they are.
I recommend you join forces with
as many comrades as you can find.
Are you ready to enter the Red Flower
where Morocc is believed to be hiding?
scripts.translation:
[資深追蹤者]
要對抗夢羅克，光靠幾個戰士可不行，實力再強也不夠。
建議你儘可能多找些同伴。
準備好進入夢羅克可能藏身的紅色花朵了嗎？

scripts.text: No.
scripts.translation: 不

scripts.text: Yes.
scripts.translation: 是的

scripts.text:
[Senior Tracker]
Come back
if you change your mind.
scripts.translation:
[資深追蹤者]
改變主意的話再來吧。

scripts.text:
[Senior Tracker]
The entrance to the Red Flower
is not open yet.
Please come back later
and try again.
scripts.translation:
[資深追蹤者]
紅色花朵的入口還沒開啟，請稍後再來。

scripts.text:
[Senior Tracker]
The entrance to the Red Flower
has opened.
It will only stay open for a while.
You'd better use it
while you can.
scripts.translation:
[資深追蹤者]
紅色花朵的入口已經開啟，但只能維持一段時間。
趕快趁現在進去吧。

scripts.text:
[Senior Tracker]
This is our advance base
to stop Morocc.
I'm a tracker
charged with leading my army
to Morocc's lair.
scripts.translation:
[資深追蹤者]
這裡是阻止夢羅克的前進基地。
我是追蹤者，負責引導軍隊前往他的巢穴。

scripts.text:
[Senior Tracker]
After a painstaking search,
I've located
the place with the highest chance of
hiding Morocc inside.
scripts.translation:
[資深追蹤者]
費了好大一番工夫，終於找到了夢羅克最有可能藏身的地方。

scripts.text:
[Senior Tracker]
According to my intel,
Morocc is hiding out in this place,
trying to recover
his full strength.
scripts.translation:
[資深追蹤者]
據情報，夢羅克就藏在這裡，試圖恢復全部力量。

scripts.text:
[Senior Tracker]
Even though I've located this place myself,
I have to admit
that I'm not equipped to
explore it by myself.
I'm a tracker after all, not a fighter.
scripts.translation:
[資深追蹤者]
地方雖然是我找到的，可我也得承認，自己還沒本事獨自進去探索。
畢竟我是追蹤者，不擅長戰鬥。

scripts.text:
[Senior Tracker]
You look like
a warrior spoiling for
a good fight with Morocc,
and I think
you have a chance at winning it.
scripts.translation:
[資深追蹤者]
看你的樣子，應該正渴望與夢羅克大戰一場吧？
我覺得你有機會贏。

scripts.text:
[Senior Tracker]
How'd you like to
enter Morocc's lair,
defeat him,
and become the hero
who saved the world from evil?
scripts.translation:
[資深追蹤者]
要不要闖進夢羅克的巢穴，打敗他，成為將世界從邪惡中拯救出來的英雄？

scripts.text:
[Senior Tracker]
If you're interested in my proposition,
let me talk to your party leader.
We'll discuss more details together.
scripts.translation:
[資深追蹤者]
對這個提議感興趣的話，請你們隊長來，我們再詳細商量。

scripts.text:
[Senior Tracker]
Morocc may not have recovered his full strength, but fighting him still
takes more than a few warriors, no matter how strong they are.
I recommend you join forces with
as many comrades as you can find.
Are you ready to enter the Red Flower
where Morocc is believed to be hiding?
scripts.translation:
[資深追蹤者]
夢羅克也許還沒恢復全部力量，可要對抗他，光靠幾個戰士仍然不夠，實力再強也不行。
建議你儘可能多找些同伴。
準備好進入夢羅克可能藏身的紅色花朵了嗎？

scripts.text: No.
scripts.translation: 不

scripts.text: Yes.
scripts.translation: 是的

scripts.text:
[Senior Tracker]
Come back
if you change your mind.
scripts.translation:
[資深追蹤者]
改變主意的話再來吧。

scripts.text:
[Senior Tracker]
The entrance to the Red Flower
is not open yet.
Please come back later
and try again.
scripts.translation:
[資深追蹤者]
紅色花朵的入口還沒開啟，請稍後再來。

scripts.text:
[Senior Tracker]
The entrance to the Red Flower
has opened.
It will only stay open for a while.
You'd better use it
while you can.
scripts.translation:
[資深追蹤者]
紅色花朵的入口已經開啟，但只能維持一段時間。
趕快趁現在進去吧。

scripts.text:
[Senior Tracker]
Finally you're back!
What happened in there?
scripts.translation:
[資深追蹤者]
你終於回來了！
裡面發生了什麼？

scripts.text:
- You relay
your experience in the Red Flower. -
scripts.translation: - 你講述在紅色花朵中的經歷。-

scripts.text:
[Senior Tracker]
So Morocc got away.
That's a shame.
scripts.translation:
[資深追蹤者]
所以夢羅克逃走了。
真遺憾。

scripts.text:
[Senior Tracker]
At least
you wiped out
his army.
That's an accomplishment in itself.
scripts.translation:
[資深追蹤者]
至少你消滅了他的軍隊，這本身就是一份戰功。

scripts.text:
[Senior Tracker]
At least we know
where he is.
Could you come back tomorrow
and help me track
him down again?
I'll be waiting here.
scripts.translation:
[資深追蹤者]
至少我們知道他在哪裡。
明天能再來幫我追蹤他嗎？我會在這裡等你。
